profile.headline: I design software people actually enjoy using. Full-Stack Developer • UI/UX Designer • Solutions Architect
profile.summary:
A unique blend of designer, developer, and architect.
 
My career began in television as a graphic designer and 3D animator, where I spent eight years crafting visual experiences before founding GrafxLab and later joining GL2. That creative foundation continues to shape how I approach software today.
 
I specialize in designing and building applications from the user experience outward—combining UI/UX design, full-stack development, and software architecture. My toolkit spans Angular (versions 2 through 21), React, .NET, C#, SQL Server, Postgres, and modern cloud and DevOps platforms including Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub. On the design side, I work in Figma to build wireframes, prototypes, and design systems before a single line of code is written. Working across multiple programming languages, along with database, cloud, and systems design, I focus on creating applications that are both technically robust and genuinely enjoyable to use.
 
Building software that users love may appear simple on the surface, but achieving that simplicity is often the most complex—and most rewarding—part of the process.
 
From Fortune 100 companies to startups, I have designed and developed more than 50 mission-critical projects that organizations rely on to run their businesses—including work for FedEx, Bank of America, Trimble, Deloitte, Ernst & Young, and the TSA, such as a secure identity-enrollment system now running in 750+ locations across 43 states and a financial risk platform supporting roughly $4.4 trillion in assets. I've also designed and built healthcare applications for organizations including St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, 21st Century Oncology, and myNexus, working within HIPAA-regulated environments, along with a real-time patient monitoring interface built in React.
 
Beyond hands-on delivery, I've led technical teams and mentored developers throughout my career—standing up Azure DevOps and Agile/Scrum practices, managing offshore development teams, and setting standards for code quality, architecture, and maintainability. Being trusted with systems used every day by organizations ranging from the U.S. Federal Government to some of the nation's most respected medical institutions is a responsibility I take seriously, and I'm proud to play a part in their success.
 
Based in Nashville, TN. Open to full-stack development, UI/UX design, and technical leadership opportunities.

positions.description: Software developer, architect and U.I. designer specializing in custom applications for business. Worked on more than 40 projects within the financial, healthcare, transportation, logistics and manufacturing sectors. Assist business stakeholders with technology recommendations, project planning, and resource management. Help companies adopt best practices in areas of security, testing, integration and deployment.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Managed software development, maintenance of 25 legacy Windows applications that manage scheduling, product configuration, and other essential processes used in the company's operations.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: As a senior software developer, solutions architect, and UI/UX designer for GL2, a development partner, I had the opportunity to work with more than 30 clients on more than 100 enterprise projects for organizations across healthcare, finance, logistics, manufacturing, and government.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded a multi-media company that specialized in 3D Animation, broadcast television commercials, interactive presentations and print design. Led a team of 12 artists, animators, editors and administrative staff.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Experience · Prototyping · Front-End Development

positions.title: Producer
positions.description: At 19 years old, FM100 in Memphis handed me one of the few 300,000 watt radio stations in the United States each Saturday night. I would go in at 10:00 AM and work until 6:00 PM producing, "Saturday Night HotMix", a show that ran from 9:00 PM to Midnight. I created 157 shows during that time and was named the South's best DJ in a competition against 25 other dj's.

positions.title: Artist / 3D Animator
positions.description:
It's funny how I got this job. I visited WMC-TV during a career day after receiving Eagle Scout in the Boy Scouts of America. At the end of my tour that day I asked how the graphics were done that appeared over the shoulder during newscasts. I was introduced to the art director and ended up spending two hours hanging out with him. I had been a photographer since I was 13 years old and he appreciated my enthusiasm. That day he offered me a job. I was 17 years old.

For the next 8 years I created news graphics, television show openings and commercials. It was a great experience and many of the values I carry today such as never missing a deadline I learned doing this job.
